reasons.action: The brief explicitly asks for a new temporal motion — the car pulling forward — so the action is request-governed rather than the static pose of the photo.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action look; rendering medium is pinned by the schema and no restyling is requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested for the supercar, so its observed carbon fibre body is retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: 'Out of the dark' describes the already-dark showroom and the car's motion, not an instruction about a light source or its direction, so the observed lighting is retained.
reasons.framing: No shot scale, viewpoint, composition or camera movement is specified, so the reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; the dark tones are the observed environment rather than an incidental object color, so reference palette governs.
